# `scene.separate`: Separate

Splits a mesh object into several objects by loose part, material or face group.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(V + H + F) plus O(groups x slots)
- Flags: undoable, creates_objects
- Also known as: p, split, separate by loose parts, extract, detach

The first part stays in the target object; the others become siblings with the same transform. Vertices on the border between parts are duplicated. With `by: groups` each listed face group becomes an object named after it.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `by` | `SeparateBy` | `"loose_parts"` | How to split: `loose_parts` (default), `material` or `groups`. |
| `groups` | `string[]` | `[]` | Face groups for `by: groups`; faces in none of them stay in the target. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"by":"groups","groups":["top"],"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `separated crate (o:1) into 2 objects: crate (o:1), top (o:5)`
